show: The Bible in a Year (with Fr. Mike Schmitz)

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Texte aus dem Begleittext des Podcasters, kein Transkript - ohne Zeitachse sind Clips und Sprungmarken unmoeglich

einzeiler: Readings from Jeremiah, Lamentations, and Proverbs focusing on judgment.
kurzfassung: Fr. Mike continues reading from the book of Jeremiah with a focus on God’s judgment against the nations surrounding Israel. The episode also includes a meditation on the words of the prophets to encourage personal repentance. Today’s featured texts are Jeremiah 47-48, Lamentations 2, and Proverbs 18:1-4.

beschreibung:
Fr. Mike continues reading from the book of Jeremiah and emphasizes God’s judgment against the nations surrounding Israel. Fr. Mike also invites us to meditate on the words of the prophets and repent for our own failures and shortcomings. Today’s readings are Jeremiah 47-48, Lamentations 2, and Proverbs 18:1-4.

For the complete reading plan, visit ascensionpress.com/bibleinayear.

Please note: The Bible contains adult themes that may not be suitable for children - parental discretion is advised.
